description: Controller heartbeat comparing the hash of the loaded PLC program against its attested programCid, re-verified on every controller restart and daily heartbeat. A mismatch freezes L3 recipe dispatch to that controller until resolved. Per ADR-2606111000 §4.

dispatchFrozen.description: true when match=false and L3 dispatch is refused

envelopeClampCount.description: cumulative clamp counter sampled at heartbeat

resolutionNote.description: on recovery from a mismatch: what happened (incl. deliberate drills, which MUST be recorded as drills per ADR-2606111100 §5)
